name: ISM Design System

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Header bar, dark sections and the footer; primary text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: charcoal-900
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on dark, mobile drawer, app chrome; default text colour on light pages.

tokens.name: charcoal-800
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces and hover fills on dark.

tokens.name: charcoal-700
tokens.usage: Deep neutral for print and illustration; not used for UI text.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Body and lead copy on off-white and white (7.6:1 on off-white).

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions and metadata on white (6.1:1) and off-white (5.7:1).

tokens.name: gray-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text only, on white (5.1:1).

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks; never body copy (4.0:1 on white, use for 18px+ or non-text).

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Strong borders: field outlines on hover, segmented tracks, chip borders.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, table rules, light hover fill on white buttons.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Sand sections, input tracks, skeleton loaders, list hover on light.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Page background for light sections.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus and text on dark.

tokens.name: horizon-blue
tokens.usage: THE action colour: one primary button per group, links, focus ring, selected states. Text on white 4.9:1; white on it 4.9:1.

tokens.name: horizon-blue-dim
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed primary, eyebrow text, info text, verse numbers (7.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Accent fills: progress, charts, avatar initials, illustration. Not for text on white.

tokens.name: blue-on-dark
tokens.usage: Links, active tabs and eyebrow text on black/charcoal (8.7:1 on black).

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, checked check-rows, info banner background, menu hover.

tokens.name: blue-tint-line
tokens.usage: Border of info banners and selected tiles on blue-tint.

tokens.name: gradient-blue
tokens.usage: First stop of the signature gradient.

tokens.name: gradient-violet
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the signature gradient; violet accent fills.

tokens.name: gradient-gold
tokens.usage: Last stop of the signature gradient; stat numerals on dark.

tokens.name: gradient-peach
tokens.usage: Soft warm accent for print washes and illustration.

tokens.name: gold-tint

tokens.name: leather-gold

description: ISM Design System tokens. Single source of truth. Edit this file, then run `npm run build:tokens`. Never edit generated files.

zIndex.note: One global stacking scale. Components never invent z-index numbers; they use these. Local overlap inside one component uses z-raised (2) and z-behind (-1).

tokens.name: z-behind
tokens.usage: Decorative layers behind content (hero glow, texture, gradient washes).

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Overlap inside one component: badge over an image, selected tab over its track, in-cell tooltip.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists and autocomplete results anchored to a field.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky in-page bars such as AnchorNav.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Site header (fixed).

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Drawer scrim.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile navigation drawer.

tokens.name: z-cookie
tokens.usage: Cookie banner.

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Floating controls: BackToTop, Fab.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region. Above modals so confirmations are never hidden. (Was 80 before v3.)

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips that escape their container (portalled).

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip link when focused. Always the top layer.

motion.note: Restrained motion: 150ms for state changes, 200ms for elevation and fades, 260ms for drawers, 400ms for entrances. No scale on buttons. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

duration.name: duration-fast
duration.usage: Hover, focus, pressed colour and border changes on controls.

duration.name: duration-base
duration.usage: Card elevation, scrim fades, accordion icon rotation.

duration.name: duration-enter
duration.usage: Entrance rise of sections and the cookie banner.

duration.name: duration-spin
duration.usage: One rotation of the loading spinner.

duration.name: duration-pulse
duration.usage: On-air live dot pulse (the only looping decoration).

easing.name: ease-drawer
easing.usage: Drawers and sheets: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Text also keeps a 4.5:1 contrast only where it is not decorative; disabled text is exempt from WCAG contrast but must not be the only signal.

tokens.name: scrim-peek
tokens.usage: App bottom sheet at peek height.

tokens.name: scrim-sheet
tokens.usage: App bottom sheet expanded, action sheet.

tokens.name: scrim-drawer
tokens.usage: Website mobile drawer.

tokens.name: scrim-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialog backdrop.

tokens.name: overlay-photo
tokens.usage: Minimum dark overlay before placing text or a logo on a photo.

elevation.note: Five levels. Pick the lowest that separates the surface; never stack two shadows.

levels.name: flat
levels.use: Sections, inline panels, anything divided by a hairline only.

levels.name: resting
levels.use: Cards and panels at rest on light surfaces.

levels.name: overlay
levels.use: Menus, dropdowns, popovers, modals, toasts, action sheets.

levels.name: dark-panel
levels.use: Drawer, cookie banner, dark sheets and panels.

levels.name: focus
levels.use: Keyboard focus halo, always with a 2px horizon-blue outline.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense desktop toolbars only (.btn-sm). Never on touch layouts.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, chips, icon buttons and list rows (equals tap-target).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (.btn-lg), hero and form submit.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text inputs, selects, search fields, tabs and vertical tabs.

tokens.name: field-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and directory search input (.input-lg).

tokens.name: row-app
tokens.usage: Minimum app list row and sheet row.

tokens.name: row-action
tokens.usage: Action sheet row and share tile.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline with small text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, navigation.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: App bars, tab bars, ministry icons at base size.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width of UI line icons (1.6 to 2.2 allowed). Unitless.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset.

breakpointsExtra.note: Mobile-first. Layouts switch at 767/768 (mobile to tablet+), 1023/1024 (full desktop nav) and 480 (compact phones). The page frame is 1280, the container 1200.

tokens.name: breakpoint-compact
tokens.usage: Max width of compact phones: single-column modal grids, 2-up share tiles.

script.note: Per-script typography. Values marked recommended are design proposals that need review by a native reader before launch. Never apply letter-spacing or uppercase to Arabic-script text; it breaks letter joining.

scripts.note: Urdu is conventionally set in Nastaliq (Noto Nastaliq Urdu). Naskh is acceptable for UI; confirm with an Urdu reader before publishing long text.
